plan.title: Counter Offer During Evaluation and Acceptance

steps.note: Open the existing RFQ Responses screen in the prepared evaluation state.
Enable counter offers on RFQ rounds as required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Send a counter offer on Vendor A's normal bid; the available state supports one countered line.
Verify the buyer's Responses grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Use the vendor portal session to accept Vendor A's pending counter offer.
Verify the buyer's Responses grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as accepted.
Open Master QCS to inspect the accepted bid in the comparison grid.
Verify the accepted countered price is shown as Vendor A's current RFQ rate.
Verify Master QCS calculates the current line amount and total from the accepted price.
